title: Orders, Transactions, Income & Sales — How They Work Together
description: Process flow, relationships, auto-populate and auto-calculate rules for the backoffice.

Order.role: The basket: what the customer bought, from whom, when.

Transaction.role: A payment event: money in/out tied to an order.
Transaction.relationship: One order can have multiple transactions (e.g. partial payments, refunds).

Sale.role: The closed deal: we sold this order for this amount.
Sale.relationship: Usually created when payment is completed (from Transaction).

Income.role: Money received by the business (P&L, reporting).
Income.relationship: Created from completed Transactions or Sales (e.g. sale, fee).

sequence: Customer pays → Transaction created (order_id, amount, status = completed)
When Transaction is completed → Sale can be auto-created (order_id, amount, invoice)
Income record(s) auto-created from Transaction/Sale (amount, type = sale or fee)

Transaction_from_Order.when: User selects an Order when creating/editing a Transaction

defaults.amount: from order total (or remaining to pay)
defaults.optional: customer/seller/date from order for display or pre-fill

Sale_from_Order_or_Transaction.when: User selects an Order or a completed Transaction when creating a Sale

defaults.amount: from completed transaction amount or order total

Income_from_Transaction_or_Sale.when: Creating Income from a Transaction or Sale

orderTotal.usage: Default Transaction amount and Sale amount from this.

transactionAmount.partialPayments: remaining = order_total - sum(transactions for this order); default next transaction to remaining.

saleAmount.formula: sale_amount = completed_transaction.amount (or order total if single payment)
saleAmount.invoiceNumber: Auto-generate (e.g. sequence or date-based) when creating Sale from Transaction.

incomeFromTransaction.description: When a Transaction is marked completed
incomeFromTransaction.action: Create Income record: amount = transaction.amount, income_type = 'sale', received_at = transaction date.

incomeFromSale.action: Create Income record: amount = sale.amount, income_type = 'sale'.

feeIncome.action: Create Income record: amount = fee_income, income_type = 'fee'.

summary.Order: Defines what was sold and the total; everything else references it (order_id).
summary.Transaction: Records payment(s) for that order; amount defaults from order; when status = completed, auto-create Sale and Income.
summary.Sale: Formal record of a completed sale; defaults from Order + Transaction; can auto-set amount and invoice number.
summary.Income: Money in; created from completed Transactions (or Sales), amount and income_type auto-set; optional fee calculation from sale amount.
